subject: shotgun
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: shotgun, in the place of the game's models/v_shotgun.mdl, models/p_shotgun.mdl, models/w_shotgun.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_crowbar.mdl, models/w_9mmar.mdl, models/w_357.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 3 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, A, A where the asset was C, B, A: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Against a straight pump shotgun, the outline is kinked. In front-left, front-right and back-left the body bends at the middle, and the top and below views show a hook-shaped flare at the stock end (below view, upper right). The first-person and in-hand views read more like a bent tool than a shotgun. The barrel-receiver-stock order is there, but the silhouette is wrong in several views.

M2.reason: Measured size is 17.1 x 3.8 x 28.2. The long side is 28.2 against the brief's 30, which is 6% short and within the 15% band.

M3.reason: Listing the brief's parts: barrel, receiver, pump (forend), stock, trigger and trigger guard, pistol grip, magazine tube, front sight, ejection port. The barrel, receiver and ribbed pump show in first-person.jpg and in-hand.png. The trigger, trigger guard, grip and magazine tube cannot be found in any side view, and the stock is a hook, not a stock. Small parts are missing, so M3 is at most 1.

M4.reason: Dark gunmetal body, dark pump and stock, as the brief asks (black metal, dark pump and stock). The first-person view matches the game's own colour and placement closely. A faint blue-purple tint on the stock pad is within what a dark metal would show.

M5.reason: The brief asks for no markings. The pump's horizontal grooves and the barrel's ribs in first-person.png are there and are not wrong for the brief. The mottled streaks on the barrel in sides.png are a texture quirk, not a fault the brief asks about.

M6.reason: Measured apart by the line-up test, which caps M6 at 2. Judges picked D, A, A where the asset was C, B, A: they did not pick the asset as the Valve-made one, so it passed for one of the game's.

M7.reason: The muzzle points forward and the gun is upright in the hand views (in-hand.png, first-person.png). The w_ model stands on its back-stock and barrel. No orientation fault shows against the brief.

M8.reason: SMAK's checks pass with no errors. 174 triangles is under both the Half-Life median band (138, twice that is 276) and the most Valve spends on its kind (291). Nothing floats or is inside out in the ten views. The small bright spots at the muzzle (Front, Back) look like a barrel bore a player sees on any gun, not a fault.

W1.reason: In first-person.png the gun sits where the game's own sits, held the same way round, with the orange glove under the grip. In attack.png (frames 0 to 20) the glove stays under the gun in every frame, and the gun swings in the picture without parting from the hand.
